title: FGTS Steel
description: Mod for FSTG server that add custom steel.
body:
FSTG offers you a steel making experience, that is both realistic and balanced, perfect for semi-realistic modpacks!

This mod includes a Blast Furnace Multiblock. To make it you need to craft a Blast Furnace Hatch. Once, you have crafted the Hatch you can see where to place the multiblock, by right-clicking it.

Make steel, by inserting iron, Flux and coal.

There are two types of Flux - Sand and Calcite. Sand Flux is obtained by washing sand and Calcite Flux is obtained by right clicking Calcite blocks with an axe.
